direction.illustration_style: Two layers: lightly illustrated Moonlit Meadow branding with botanical ornaments, crescent moons and serif typography; the crochet product rendered as realistic high-end yarn crochet product photography.
direction.shared_prompt: Premium Moonlit Meadow crochet pattern bundle. The crochet pieces are exactly those specified for each page, rendered as lifelike yarn crochet with clearly visible fibres, loops and stitch definition on a soft cream linen setting with natural product-photography lighting. Delicate botanical and crescent-moon branding ornaments and elegant serif typography.
direction.shading: Product: soft natural directional light, realistic contact shadows and dimensional depth. Branding ornaments: soft and flat.
direction.texture: Product: visible yarn fibres, crochet loops, stitches and small handmade irregularities. Background: subtle cream linen weave.
direction.detail_level: Crochet construction must remain legible at Etsy thumbnail size. Branding ornaments should remain sparse and fine.

production_note: The crochet bouquet is a rendered visualisation of the pattern outcome, not a photograph of an item supplied to the buyer.
